verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own background automation. Ongoing monitoring can be switched on per customer through the monitoring-configuration API, and Mesh's agentic workflows include Screening/Ongoing Monitoring and Transaction Monitoring agents that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases. WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks let downstream systems react without a human in the loop. However, these are vendor-defined agents rather than automations the user builds: on the Starter Plan the agent configurations are standardized and cannot be customized, and the agentic claims come only from marketing pages. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules (custom triggers, actions and schedules), documented configurability of the AI agents beyond the Starter Plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agents run autonomously.
